newsitem.title: UK: PREMIER AUTO TRUST PRICES $920 MLN ASSET-BACKED BOND.
newsitem.headline: PREMIER AUTO TRUST PRICES $920 MLN ASSET-BACKED BOND.

text.p: Premier Auto Trust 1997-2 has priced its five-tranche asset-backed bond for a total of $920 million, lead manager Bear Stearns said on Wednesday.

Class A2 notes total $250 million, pays a coupon of 6.01 percent and has an issue and reoffer price of 99.99307 to give a spread of 32 basis points over the July 1998 U.S. Treasury. It matures in November 1999, and has an average life of 0.92 years.

Class A3 notes total $235 million, pays a coupon of 6.13 percent and has an issue and reoffer price of 99.99254, to give a spread of 26 b.p over the March 1999 Treasury. It matures in September 2000 and has an average life of 1.61 years.

Class A4 notes total $200 million, pays a coupon of 6.25 percent and has an issue and reoffer price of 99.99387, to give a spred of 27 b.p over the December 1999 Treasury. It matures in June 2001 and has an avrage life of 2.33 years

Class A5 notes total $190 million, pays a coupon of 6.32 percent and has an issue and reoffer price of 99.997481, to give a spread of 28 b.p. over the three-year Treasury. It matures in March 2002 and has an average life of 3.14 years.

Class B notes total $45 million, pays a coupon of 6.53 percent and has an issue and reoffer price of 99.998345, to give a spread of 42 b.p. over the February 2001 Treasury. It matures in December 2003 and has an average life of 3.53 years.
The deal was launched on Tuesday. -- London Newsroom +44 171 542 7748
